newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin falls 17 cents to end at 13.83 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin falls 17 cents to end at 13.83 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell 17 cents to end at 13.83 ringgit ($5.50) a kg with an initial high offering and falls in London affecting sentiment.

"The market is falling because of lower London prices," a trader said, adding that buyers were also sidelined, awaiting further falls in prices. Turnover fell to 93 tonnes from 113 on Wednesday, with buying from Europe, Japan and locally.
"The market looks bearish as prices fell below the 14 ringgit level and the near-term trend is weak," the trader said.
The local price premium over London was $50 a tonne against $45 previously. --Tan Lee Lee (603-275-6834) ($1=2.5150 ringgit)
